summary: Hyde-Smith has consistently defended Israel. A 2021 Senate press release expressed disappointment that pro-Israel legislation was blocked in Congress, and 2023 remarks documented by Congress Receipts expressed support for Israel. In May 2024 she posted that 70% of Gazans viewed Hamas's October 7 attack as 'correct' and joined an effort to block Gazan refugee admission. In February 2025 she cosponsored the Antisemitism Awareness Act, directing the Education Department to adopt the IHRA definition for campus investigations.
